GamingGrounding.description: Evidence admitted to the provider context. Requested counts describe supplied URLs; fetched counts describe documents, not metadata HTTP calls. Grounded does not establish full-document coverage or answer correctness.

origin.description: Whether the URL was submitted or followed by the backend from an adapter-selected index link under its reviewed companion rule. Both consume the same candidate budget and authority checks.

idempotencyKey.description: New key per logical operation; reuse only for identical retries. Bound to the authenticated caller.

discoveryType.description: Optional operation role. Omit for legacy calls; the backend infers only its pending operation and enforces separate one-shot budgets.

expectedRevision.description: Required only for v2. Must equal the current backend workflow revision; never inferred or advanced by the frontend.

GamingHybridDiscovery.description: Bounded pending operation. verify_currentness is nonterminal even when freshness is unverified or stale. Continue the same workflow; only nextAction stop ends exhausted discovery.

round.description: Operations started for this discovery type. Zero means the permitted operation has not run; one consumes its budget. Identical same-key retries do not spend another round.

maxCandidates.description: Total acquisition slots, including submitted URLs and any adapter-required official articles followed by the backend. Submit a reviewed index alone when available to leave companion slots.

continuationRequired.description: True while this operation is permitted and must be submitted before reporting verification exhausted; false after its budget is exhausted. Follow nextAction on every response.

reviewedSources.description: Server-reviewed canonical discovery hints for the requested game and source role. These URLs are not acquired evidence or proof of currentness. Submit an applicable index/status URL using the same workflowId and a new idempotencyKey.
